final_netlist:
.subckt dut vin vout vref vss ibias
* ---- bias: IREF into diode-connected NMOS, mirrored to OTA tail ----
Mb   ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=4 L=1.68959
Mt   tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=8.2609 L=1.68959
* ---- error amplifier: NMOS input pair, PMOS mirror load (to vin) ----
* M1 (diode side) <- feedback, M2 (output side) <- vref ; output = pass gate
M1   d1    vfb   tail vss nfet W=80.3232 L=0.572245
M2   gate  vref  tail vss nfet W=80.3232 L=0.572245
M3   d1    d1    vin  vin pfet W=1.32459 L=1.67039
M4   gate  d1    vin  vin pfet W=1.32459 L=1.67039
* ---- PMOS pass device ----
Mp   vout  gate  vin  vin pfet W=534.183 L=0.335454
* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistor ----
Rz   gate  cz    15052.1
Cc   cz    vout  1.13553e-11
* ---- feedback divider (Vout = 2*Vref) with feed-forward cap ----
R1   vout  vfb   308835
R2   vfb   vss   308835
Cff  vout  vfb   7.11696e-13
.ends dut
